stem: An electric scooter was bought in Bengaluru for 96,000 rupees. Its value, in rupees, \(t\) years after it was bought is modeled by \(V(t) = 96{,}000(0.9)^{t}\). According to the model, what is the value, in rupees, of the scooter 2 years after it was bought?
verify:
t = symbols('t')
V = Lambda(t, 96000*Rational(9, 10)**t)
assert V(2) == 77760
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [V(2)]
